verdict.rationale: Swell is a commerce platform, so publishing products to AI agents and answer engines is a fair axis to judge it on. The pack has no evidence of a cross-merchant catalog, an agent-facing product feed, or answer-engine distribution. Its AI material (runtime schema introspection, JSON model files, agent tooling for the CLI) is aimed at developer agents building apps, not shopping agents discovering products, and CSV export is not an agent feed.
